notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no human reviewed or tested it and no hardware backend was run. The upstream environment is a SAPIEN + SapienIPC GPU simulation (envs/peg_insertion.py:21 imports sapien; README.md:51 requires SapienIPC); it was never imported or run. The fake backend (fake.py) is a pure Python kinematic stand-in for the non-physics rules of the upstream step; it does not simulate contacts, elastic deformation, marker motion, peg/hole geometry or success detection, and its marker_flow is a zero array of the real (2, 2, 128, 2) shape. The fake's initial offset draw, max_action, max_steps, step_penalty and final_reward are placeholder test data, not device facts or limits. The fidelity contract is F0 with timestep_ms 0 because one tick is one environment step, not a fixed physics interval; the gaps say this and the seeded determinism claim covers the fake only. The upstream registration supplies no constructor arguments and the registered subclass requires a params object (envs/peg_insertion.py:763), so gymnasium.make(env_id) alone cannot build the upstream environment; the sim backend was not run. Only the card's first entry symbol (ContinuousInsertionRandomizedMarkerEnv-v1 / ContinuousInsertionSimGymRandomizedPointFLowEnv) is covered; LongOpenLockRandPointFlowEnv is a separate sibling environment in the same repository and is not covered by this package. fixtures/conformance.json supplies a zero action so the conformance probe does not end the episode; the gate's own envelope probes still exercise the action bounds. Expected warnings, all disclosed: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge records the pending seed without a native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer/number inputs (seed twice, ticks, action.values). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line the last gate run printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
